_how_to_fill: Each row = one question; each word sits under the type it scores for (from the Personality Scoring Sheet Megan sent 2026-10-24). The taker sees the 4 words shuffled, so the order here never gives the answer away. 'means' = the plain-English meaning shown under each word (Megan 2026-10-24: our audience is young).
title: Personality Test
intro: Pick the ONE that sounds most like you. Go with your gut, there are no wrong answers.

popular.name: Popular Sanguine
popular.about:
*In the field:* You make a friend in 10 seconds, whether it's a homeowner or a business owner. People open up to you, and your energy keeps the whole team hyped.
*Level up:* Ask for the sale sooner, keep a simple checklist for your day, and let a teammate help keep you on schedule.
strengths: Keeps energy up all day, even on the last stop
Great first impression -- people want to keep talking to you
Bounces back from a no quickly
weaknesses: Talks past the close instead of asking for the sale
Shows up late or loses track of time in the field
Gets bored with a slow area and loses focus
Can chase the fun over the numbers
popular.classic: Impulsive and fun-loving. Sociable and emotional -- loves social gatherings and making new friends. Creative, often daydreams, talkative and not shy. Can struggle to follow tasks all the way through, and loses interest once something stops being fun.
team_strengths: Hypes up the team in the huddle and the group chat
Recruits easily -- people want to be on your team because you make it fun
Keeps new reps excited and coming back in their first weeks
team_weaknesses: Brings people in but forgets to train them, so they don't stick
Skips the boring parts of leading: check-ins, numbers, accountability
popular.overall: You're the life of the party. You're fun, outgoing, and full of energy, and people like you fast. You love being around people, you talk easily, and you make everything more exciting. You do your best when things feel fun and new -- and you can lose interest when they get boring or repetitive.

powerful.name: Powerful Choleric
powerful.about:
*In the field:* You're confident, you don't take a no personally, and you push through a tough day. You set the pace for the team.
*Level up:* Listen before you pitch. Lead by lifting people up, not pushing them.
strengths: Confident close -- you ask for the sale every time
Doesn't take a no personally, keeps going
Sets the pace and wants to top the sales board
weaknesses: Can come on too strong and push a customer away
Skips steps to go faster, then has to fix orders
Hard to tell you anything once your mind is made up
powerful.classic: Ambitious and leader-like. Lots of energy and passion, and tries to put it in others. Likes to be in charge of everything.
team_strengths: Takes charge of an area or a team without being asked
Builds a team fast and pushes them to big numbers
Spots who's hungry and gives them a shot to lead
team_weaknesses: Gets impatient with new reps who learn slower
Bosses teammates instead of coaching them
Burns new reps out by expecting your speed on day one
Does it all yourself instead of building leaders under you
powerful.overall: You're a born leader. You're driven, confident, and you love to win. You like being in charge, you make decisions fast, and you get things done. You push yourself hard and expect the same from everyone around you -- which can make you come off strong.

perfect.name: Perfect Melancholy
perfect.about:
*In the field:* You know the product inside and out, your orders are clean, and customers trust you because you're honest and prepared.
*Level up:* Set a daily goal and hit it, perfect or not. One no doesn't mean you did it wrong.
strengths: Knows the product and the plans better than anyone
Clean, correct orders -- fewer cancels and fix-ups
Customers trust you because you're honest and prepared
Tracks your own numbers and spots what's working
Plans your area and your day ahead of time
weaknesses: Overthinks the pitch instead of going to the next customer
Takes a no personally and replays it all day
Waits for the perfect moment that never comes
Slows down when things get messy or change last minute
perfect.classic: Introverted and thoughtful. Considerate, and worries about being on time. Creative, often a perfectionist, self-reliant and independent -- can get so locked in on the work that you forget to think of others.
team_strengths: Trains new reps the right way, step by step, so they last
Builds simple systems your team can copy
team_weaknesses: Can be hard on yourself and on teammates
Slow to recruit -- waits for the 'perfect' person
Can make new reps feel like nothing they do is good enough
perfect.overall: You're a thinker. You're careful, organized, and you care about doing things the right way. You notice details other people miss, you plan ahead, and you hold yourself to a high standard. You feel things deeply -- and you can be hard on yourself when things don't go perfectly.

peaceful.name: Peaceful Phlegmatic
peaceful.about:
*In the field:* Customers feel zero pressure with you. You're a great listener, steady every single day, and a teammate everyone can count on.
*Level up:* Practice a confident close until it feels normal, and set small daily goals to keep your energy up.
strengths: Customers feel zero pressure -- they trust you
Great listener, hears what the customer really needs
Steady every day, no big ups and downs
Stays calm with an upset customer
weaknesses: Holds back from asking for the sale
Moves slow, fewer customers talked to than you could
Avoids hard conversations with customers and teammates
Needs a push to get started in the morning
peaceful.classic: Relaxed and quiet. Content, very kind, accepting and warm. Likes stability more than change. Consistent, calm, curious and observant -- but can be passive-aggressive.
team_strengths: The teammate everyone can count on
Builds a loyal team that stays -- people feel safe with you
Patient with new reps and great at answering their questions
team_weaknesses: Goes along with the group even when you have a better idea
Doesn't ask enough people to join, so the team grows slow
Avoids holding your team accountable when numbers drop
peaceful.overall: You're the calm one. You're easygoing, kind, and steady, and people feel relaxed around you. You're a great listener, you keep the peace, and you're the same person every day. You like things stable and simple -- and sometimes you hold back when you should speak up.
